name: pest-control-backend
description: Backend for Pest Control App - Sistema de Control de Plagas

scripts.deploy:prod: copy .env.production .env && npm run build && node server.js
scripts.env:dev: copy .env.development .env && echo 'Switched to DEVELOPMENT environment' && npm run check:config
scripts.env:staging: copy .env.staging .env && echo 'Switched to STAGING environment' && npm run check:config
scripts.env:prod: copy .env.production .env && echo 'Switched to PRODUCTION environment' && npm run check:config
scripts.env:local: copy .env.local .env && echo 'Switched to LOCAL environment' && npm run check:config
scripts.env:docker: copy .env.docker .env && echo 'Switched to DOCKER environment' && npm run check:config
scripts.test:connection: node -e "require('./db').query('SELECT NOW()').then(() => console.log('✅ DB Connected')).catch(err => console.error('❌ DB Error:', err.message))"
scripts.test:ssl: node -e "const https = require('https'); const fs = require('fs'); try { fs.accessSync('./certs/cert.pem'); console.log('✅ SSL Certificates found'); } catch { console.log('❌ SSL Certificates missing'); }"
scripts.check:config: node -e "const config = require('./config'); console.log('📋 Config:', JSON.stringify({env: config.environment, apiUrl: config.apiUrl, port: config.port, ip: config.system.localIP}, null, 2))"
scripts.check:env: echo 'Current .env file:' && type .env | findstr -v PASSWORD | findstr -v SECRET
scripts.check:production: npm run check:env && npm run test:ssl && npm run test:connection
scripts.validate:env: node -e "console.log('Environment Variables:'); console.log('ENVIRONMENT:', process.env.ENVIRONMENT || 'not set'); console.log('API_URL:', process.env.API_URL || 'not set'); console.log('DB_HOST:', process.env.DB_HOST || 'not set');"
scripts.build: echo 'No build step required for Node.js backend'
scripts.logs:prod: echo 'Production logs are minimal for security'
scripts.backup:check: echo 'DB backup configuration: enabled with 30-day retention'
